book.name: 2 Jon
book.title: 2 Jon Jon köp aŋ u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Yad nɨbi bɨ Jisas Krais nɨp nɨŋ udpal gau kalɨp abad mɨdpin. Kalöp, nɨbi God hadame nöp udnabin a ga u abe, ñɨ pai nɨpe abe, kalöp köp i kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkabin. Yad kalöp mɨdmagö yabɨƚ lɨbin. Pen yad nöp wasö, nɨbi bɨ Jisas Krais manö nɨŋö nɨŋ udpal gau magöŋhalö kalöp mɨdmagö lɨbal.
Kalöp mɨdmagö lɨbun u, Jisas Krais manö nɨŋö nɨŋ udno, hanɨp mɨdmagö aŋ daŋ kamɨŋ mɨdöm, pör pör nöp mɨdeinab.
Nap God abe, Ñɨ nɨpe Jisas Krais abe, hanɨp mög nɨŋmil ud aij gɨmil, abad mɨd aij gɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, hon Jisas Krais manö nɨŋö nɨŋ udöl gɨ mɨdun, pen pen mɨdmagö löl gɨ mɨdeinabun.
Jisas Krais manö nɨŋö nɨŋ udöl gɨ, pen pen mɨdmagö löl gɨ mɨdaimim
Ñɨ pai kale rɨmnap Jisas Krais manö nɨŋö nɨŋ udöl gɨ, hagöp rö gaböl u nɨŋem, yad mɨñ mɨñ yabɨƚ gɨpin; Bapi hanɨp anɨg gɨmim, a ga.
Pen nɨbi aij. Yad nöp manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkem hagabin, hon mɨdmagö pen pen lɨ mɨdaiun. Manö anɨbi manö gɨsön nɨbö ap wasö; God nɨpe hadame dagol gau iƚ göm, manö kƚö hagöm, manö anɨbi haga.

God manö kƚö hagöm, anɨg gɨmim, a ga rö nöp geinabun u, God nɨp mɨdmagö lun, nɨbi bɨ gau abe kalɨp mɨdmagö lɨnabun. God nɨpe hadame dagol gau iƚ göm, manö kƚö hagöm, manö anɨbi hagö nɨŋbim: kale magöŋhalö pen pen mɨdmagö lɨmim.
Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap manö piral hag ñɨbal

Nɨbi bɨ God Manö hagabun, a göm, manö piral hag ajaböl gau, kale iru mɨdpal. Kale hagpal, “Jisas Krais nɨpe hañ romaŋ löm, ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i auaga,” a gɨpal. Nɨbi bɨ anɨg gɨpal gau, kale bɨ piral hagep bɨ, bɨ Jisas Krais Nɨp Mulu Kal Nɨŋeb Bɨ.
Pen kale nɨŋ aij gɨmim. Wasö u, wög nɨp gɨpim u hir gɨnɨm rö löp. Nɨŋ aij gɨmim, God kalöp nan aij ñɨnabin a ga u magöŋhalö udmim.
Nɨbi bɨ Krais manö hag ña u arö göm, manö piral rɨmnap udnaböl gau, God nɨp aip jɨm ñöl mɨdagpal; nɨbi bɨ Krais manö hag ña u nɨŋ udöl gɨ nöp mɨdpal gau, Bapi Ñɨ apil mɨhau aip jɨm ñöl mɨdpal.
Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalöp God Manö hag ñɨnɨg auaiöl, nɨŋ aij gɨmim, kalɨp udmim. Manö kabö göl anɨbu arö göm, manö piral rɨmnap hagaiöl, kalɨp hag wɨhai dam ram kale raul daŋ ud aragmim.
Nɨhön gɨnɨg: nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau kalɨp hag wɨhai uɫ gɨ dam ram kale ud arbe, manö piral kale hagpal anɨbu, kale ke abe hagpim rö lɨnab.
Yad kalöp manö iru mɨdöp gau kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkbnep u pen köp ñɨg ig nöp rɨkagnabin; yad ke amem, kalöp amgö nɨŋem, aip asɨk mɨdun manö hagun, mɨñ mɨñ yabɨƚ gɨnabun.
Nɨbi aij. Nañɨn mɨdmagö ne aui mɨdöp ñɨ pai nɨpe nöp, “Mɨdpan?” a gɨpal.
